name: Mandate Authentication 1
definition: Specifies the transport authentication details related to the mandate.

MessageAuthenticationCode.name: Message Authentication Code
MessageAuthenticationCode.definition: Specifies a piece of information used to authenticate a message, that is to confirm that the message came from the stated sender (its authenticity) and has not been changed in transit (its integrity).

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date when the authentication was conducted.

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.definition: Channel used to transmit the authentication information.
